meaning.zh:
“一下子”，“一举”，“突然”。

这个短语源自莎士比亚的悲剧《麦克白》。其中一个角色使用 “one fell swoop” 来描述一场突然的、毁灭性的打击。如今，这个短语被用来表示一次行动或事件中突然完成某些事情，或在一次行动中同时得到多个结果。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from Shakespeare's tragedy "Macbeth". One of the characters uses "one fell swoop" to describe a sudden, devastating blow. Nowadays, the phrase is used to denote achieving something abruptly in one action or simultaneously obtaining multiple results with one effort.

lines.en: He finished all his assignments in one fell swoop.
lines.zh: 他一下子就完成了所有的作业。

lines.en: The company launched three new products in one fell swoop.
lines.zh: 公司一下子推出了三款新产品。

lines.en: She cleaned the entire house in one fell swoop.
lines.zh: 她一下子就打扫了整个房子。
